summary: Review concurrent state transitions for lost updates, check-then-act races, lock scope, optimistic concurrency and duplicate side effects.

must_inspect.why: Read-modify-write paths require concurrency control when concurrent writers can violate an invariant.
false_positive_guards: Concurrent code is not automatically racy; establish shared mutable state and interleaving.

must_inspect.why: Parallel workers or requests must not duplicate non-idempotent external effects.
false_positive_guards: Do not report a race solely from multiple workers when work ownership is atomically claimed.
Treat this pack as review configuration, not as evidence or an automatic severity increase.
